decision: Publication of v9.0.2-motrix.3 is blocked pending a new explicit maintainer decision for this complete changed scope and all 42 residual advisories (1 Critical, 18 High, 19 Medium, 4 Low). Formal .2 run 36819481774 failed closed in secret-free pre-sign checks after all six candidate and four independent builds completed; neither signing nor publication was reached. Candidate .3 adds O_BINARY to protected low-level regular-file readers, a deterministic linker ad-hoc baseline on both macOS architectures, and bounded read-only x64 NASM evidence in exact input/rebuild comparison and final verification. The NASM evidence is not executed by signing jobs or included in distributed payloads. Native Windows reader regressions and macOS ad-hoc checks are required in CI. BUILD_REVISION changes, but locked source archives/URLs, toolchains, official Action commits, and all inventoried advisories are unchanged. Audit 36807648066 remains the same-day complete inventory; no vulnerability is claimed fixed or wholly unreachable, including cache service/extraction and signature type-binding risks. The previous .1 and .2 exceptions are single-version decisions and cannot authorize .3; both annotated tags remain immutable. All file/race/size/hash guards, independent clean rebuilds, Developer ID signing/notarization, Ed25519 authentication, Immutable Releases, and protected-Environment confirmations remain required. This blocked record grants no Environment approval or release authority.
